name: Animal Rights
overview: Scripture teaches that God has given mankind dominion over animals, entrusting humans with responsible stewardship rather than exploitation, as seen in Genesis 1:26. While humans are granted the earth’s resources for sustenance (Genesis 1:29), they are also called to show care and compassion toward animals, exemplified by the command not to muzzle an ox while it works (Deuteronomy 25:4) and the righteous regard for the life of their beasts (Proverbs 12:10). Moreover, God’s provision for the birds, who neither sow nor reap, reminds believers of their greater value and the call to trust in God’s care while exercising kindness to His creatures (Matthew 6:26).
